context: Request: completed Capital Markets offerings whose proceeds were earmarked primarily for general corporate purposes, with proof of the earmark and of closing. Rubric: 1045-00001 (Belmont Ridge Bank subordinated notes) as qualifying, its use-of-proceeds and closing documents, and a precision criterion permitting only 1045-00001 and 1014-00001; 1009-00001 (Skybridge convertible-note bridge) is outside the set.

stages.note: Whole-store glob with a file-type count.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts all matter folders and prints the first and last twenty names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all paths for offering and proceeds words, plus a content grep over .docx files that returns nothing; the review flags the cut-off lists.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: widened document-name patterns; 279 hits across 67 matters and the rest of the earlier list.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction scan times out twice; reads the partial shard files (about 180K chars) and tallies hits per matter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: shard coverage check shows hits in 31 matters; a tighter store-wide rerun times out.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Keyword-filtered file listing for every matter in the union of earlier hits (211 matters, about 142K chars); the review flags the filter and a hand-picked shortlist.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: file counts per matter of the union; no paths listed.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads offering memoranda, prospectuses and closing documents of about ten candidates, a snippet script over ten offering documents (about 520K chars), and closing papers of a note financing; one path is not found.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads offering and closing documents of four more candidates to confirm exclusions; the review lists many surfaced matters never opened.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three matters as qualifying, including a convertible-note bridge financing sold under a note purchase agreement, with exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path check against the workspace root fails, the rerun on the output folder finds all paths.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the openings of the offering and closing documents of the three included matters; no edit.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It read the right offerings but also wrote a privately placed note financing as a qualifying offering.

first_error.why: The answer asserts a privately placed convertible-note bridge financing as a qualifying offering beside the two acceptable ones (evidence seen at [88]-[93]).

first_error.why: The answer asserts a privately placed convertible-note bridge financing as a qualifying offering beside the two acceptable ones (evidence seen at [94]-[100], [105]-[113]).

divergence: All fail. T0 and T2 failed the same way: they surfaced and read the acceptable offerings and wrote them as qualifying, but also included a privately placed convertible-note bridge financing at the write stage; no review questioned it (reviews pushed for wider coverage). T1 failed earlier: its summary scan surfaced the needed matter, but at the reading stage it chose other candidates and never opened it, then wrote three private financings as qualifying. In T0 and T1 the reading stage was declared as reads from the file listing despite the label note.
